title: A Day on Venus Is Longer Than Its Year
description:
Venus spins so slowly that one day there lasts longer than a full trip around the Sun. Plus three more facts that sound fake but aren't.

#shorts #space #facts

scenes.text: On Venus, a single day lasts longer than an entire year.
It takes Venus 243 Earth days to spin once, but only 225 days to orbit the Sun.
A teaspoon of neutron star would weigh around a billion tons.
The footprints astronauts left on the Moon could last for millions of years, because there's no wind to blow them away.
And there are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on every beach on Earth.
Which one surprised you most? Tell me in the comments.
